args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates, but full integration took roughly twice as long as originally planned.
- The biggest realized savings came from a reduction in mis-picks (companion article finding).
- Overall takeaway: automation delivers strong throughput and accuracy gains, but implementation timelines should be budgeted with significant buffer.
